evidenceRules: Every activated row names one exact catalog model and one symptom; a catalog identity alone never creates coverage.

Manufacturer model pages corroborate identity, topology, and feature gates only; they are not troubleshooting evidence.
Shared profiles contain only the intersection of low-risk observable checks across the cohort.
Feature-specific steps, internal access, exact-part claims, and commerce remain excluded without separate exact-revision proof.

cohorts.applicability: Exact listed built-in dishwasher; common loading, cycle, detergent, water-temperature, and visible spray-path observations only.
featureGates: Filter removal is excluded unless the exact model manual independently confirms the procedure.
Feature-specific spray systems and auto-open hardware are not generalized.
exceptions: Cycle names, filter layouts, and spray systems vary by exact revision.
Hot water, steam, broken glass, active leaking, or internal access is an immediate stop.

cohorts.applicability: Exact listed built-in dishwasher; household water, visible supply path, door state, and displayed fill error observations only.
featureGates: Use only a dry, reachable household shutoff; do not move the appliance.
No inlet-valve, float, kickplate, or panel access.
exceptions: Display codes and control names vary by exact revision.
Wet electrical areas, stuck valves, or inaccessible plumbing require a professional stop.

cohorts.applicability: Exact listed built-in dishwasher; visible water location, suds, loading, door seal, and reachable household plumbing observations only.
featureGates: Bosch E15 and manufacturer leak-detected conditions stop at service.
Do not level, loosen mounting screws, remove a kickplate, or manipulate internal leak sensors.
exceptions: Leak-protection and auto-open features vary by exact revision.
Water near power, spreading water, hot water, or an inaccessible shutoff is an immediate stop.

cohorts.applicability: Exact listed vented electric dryer; visible power, door, control-lock, cycle, and start observations only.
featureGates: Electric-dryer household breaker guidance applies; no outlet, cord-terminal, or panel access.
Control Lock and cycle names must be read from the exact console/manual.
exceptions: Smart controls and start gestures vary by exact revision.
Burn marks, damaged cords, repeated breaker trips, smoke, or burning odor require an immediate electrician/service stop.

cohorts.applicability: Exact listed vented electric dryer; heated-cycle, lint screen, load, and visible household vent observations only.
featureGates: This cohort excludes compact ventless/heat-pump dryers.
No terminal-block, heating-element, cabinet, or internal-duct access.
exceptions: Eco/energy modes and diagnostic tests vary by exact revision and are not generalized.
Burning odor, smoke, scorched lint, repeated breaker trips, or a hot cord requires an immediate stop.

cohorts.applicability: Exact listed vented electric dryer; load, door, error, cycle-start, and visible drum-motion observations only.
featureGates: Do not turn the drum by hand or inspect a belt.
No internal drive diagnosis or part inference.
exceptions: Display behavior varies by exact revision.
Scraping, burning odor, smoke, a jammed drum, or damaged power connection requires service without another test.

cohorts.applicability: Exact listed full-size French-door or side-by-side refrigerator; temperature setting, cooling mode, door seal, airflow, room condition, and food-safety observations only.
featureGates: Use the exact console/manual for cooling-mode controls; no generic button sequence.
No panel, coil, fan, compressor, or refrigerant-system access.
exceptions: Compartment controls and convertible zones vary by exact revision.
Unsafe food temperature, electrical damage, smoke, chemical odor, or water near power is an immediate stop.

cohorts.applicability: Exact listed full-size refrigerator with a factory water/ice system; visible source, filter area, dispenser, supply line, and dry reachable shutoff observations only.
featureGates: Factory water/ice feature is confirmed on the exact model source before activation.
Do not pull the refrigerator, remove covers, disconnect tubing, or infer a filter/valve part.
exceptions: Filter type, reservoir, pitcher, and ice layout vary by exact revision.
Spreading water, water near power, a hidden shutoff, or a damaged line is an immediate stop.

cohorts.applicability: Exact listed full-size refrigerator with a factory ice maker; power state, compartment temperature, water supply, filter age, door seal, and visible ice-bin observations only.
featureGates: Factory ice-maker presence is confirmed on the exact model source before activation.
No generic reset/test-button sequence, internal access, or replacement-part inference.
exceptions: Ice-maker location, controls, and dual-ice features vary by exact revision.
A leak, damaged wiring, hot/burning odor, sharp obstruction, or unresolved error requires service.
